about_us.title: You already have the data. The bottleneck is turning signals into action.
about_us.description: Cameras, telemetry, fatigue detectors and location systems each see a different part of the same operation. When they live in separate platforms, the team must rebuild context before acting. Axios creates the layer between signals and intervention.

pain_points.title: Fragmented sources
pain_points.description: Operational context is spread across multiple platforms, forcing constant screen switching and manual reconstruction of what is happening.

pain_points.title: Too many alerts, too little context
pain_points.description: A single event may say very little. Criticality changes when fatigue, speed, distraction, route and history converge in the same window.

pain_points.title: Decisions without traceability
pain_points.description: Without a single workflow, it is hard to know what was prioritized, who intervened, which action was taken and whether it resolved the operational risk.

flow.title: Four stages, one decision flow.
flow.description: The goal is not another screen for every technology. It is to turn scattered signals into a prioritized, explainable and actionable operational queue.

steps.title: Integrate
steps.description: Connect the sources the operation already uses and normalize the signals required by the decision workflow.

steps.title: Contextualize
steps.description: Group events by driver, vehicle, journey, location and time window to reconstruct operational context.

steps.title: Prioritize
steps.description: Combine rules, models and context to estimate operational criticality and order what needs attention first.

steps.title: Orchestrate
steps.description: Recommend the next action, record the intervention and preserve an auditable trail for analysis and continuous improvement.

results.title: A decision layer on top of the technologies your operation already uses.
results.description: Axios brings signals, context and rules into one workflow so the operator knows what deserves attention and what to do next.

intelligence.title: Axios Intelligence Layer
intelligence.description: The intelligence lies in combining signals and turning that context into a traceable operational decision.
items: Signal fusion within the same time window
Criticality by driver, vehicle and context

score.title: Criticality that can be explained.
score.description: Axios Score organizes priority within an operational time window by combining signals and context. Interpretation depends on the operation, the window and the available data, so every calculation should be traceable.
principles: Tracking of false alerts and missed alerts

measurement.title: A pilot should improve decisions, not merely produce more alerts.
measurement.description: Deployment creates value only if it changes how the operation works. We therefore measure response, intervention quality and recurrence with explicit periods and denominators.

cards.title: Time to intervention
cards.description: How long it takes from a relevant signal to prioritization and effective action by the team.

cards.title: Useful-alert rate
cards.description: What share of alerts actually led to a decision or intervention considered relevant by the operation.

cards.title: False intervention
cards.description: How many actions were triggered unnecessarily, creating avoidable operational cost or friction.

cards.title: Missed alert
cards.description: Which important situations were not prioritized and were only identified later.
